name: Energy Emanation
text:
Frequency once per day

---

Energy bursts forth from your body. You deal ceil@actor.level/2d6 @actor.flags.system.elementalHeartDwarf.damageType damage to all adjacent creatures (basic Reflex save save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 3rd level, and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d6 damage.
